text:
maya: Heads-up — product wants traces surfaced in the rollout dashboard so PMs can see per-route error traces during canaries. Need cross-team plan.
liam: +1. Do we want to rely on existing x-request-id, or add a dedicated x-rw-trace header?
ash: fyi, edge already injects x-request-id for routing. It's not a full trace context (no parent/span ids).
sofia: For dashboards we need correlation that ties logs, metrics, and spans. Ideally a single header that carries traceid/spanid/sampleflag.
maya: Agree. Proposal: accept incoming traceparent (W3C) if present, fall back to x-rw-trace. Runtime should emit span ids into our logs and metrics tags.
liam: Sounds good. What's sampling strategy? We can't double our observability costs.
ash: Suggestion: probabilistic global rate (0.1%) + adaptive on-error rule (sample 100% of 5xx traces) + burst cap per route (e.g., 50/min).
sofia: UX ask — console wants: sampled rate per route, traces per minute, top error spans with example span stack, link to logs via trace id, and a canary toggle to surface only canary traffic.
maya: Also need to consider privacy: redact user identifiers before sending traces to hosted backend. Apply PII scrubbing at the runtime boundary.
liam: Implementation tasks: 1) runtime: parse traceparent/x-rw-trace, generate spanids, attach to logs/metrics. 2) infra/ingest: accept trace payloads, enforce sampling policy, surface metrics. 3) console: new dashboard tiles + trace viewer link.
nash: Runtime snippet I can add quickly:
```
# pseudo-config
headers:
  accept-trace: ["traceparent", "x-rw-trace"]
sampling:
  global_p: 0.001
  on_error: true
  per_route_cap: 50/min
emit:
  log_field: rw_trace_id
  metric_tag: trace.sampled
```
liam: For ingest: we should stomp duplicate traces (dedupe by traceid) and capture metadata: model, route, customer-id (hashed), region.
sofia: Console design question — how to show sampling bias? Need a small disclaimer and sampling % shown on each chart. Also an option to 'force sample' for a given request id for repro.
maya: Operational concern: rollout of header change must be backwards compatible. Plan: 1) announce; 2) runtime starts accepting both; 3) ingest adds support; 4) console shows traces only when trace header present OR when sampled server-side.
liam: Who owns the rollout? Runtime team for header + logs, Infra for ingest + policy, Console for UI. Let's pick owners: runtime -> @ash, infra -> @liam, console -> @sofia.
nash: I'll add a short PR to runtime repo with the header parsing + log field. Will include unit tests.
nash: question for infra — how do we surface sampled_count & sample_rate metrics to the console? Prometheus? OTLP?
liam: Ingest will emit OTLP metrics and a lightweight prometheus export per-customer per-route (rate, sampled_count). We'll add labels: route, region, customer_tier.
sofia: For the 'force sample' flow: console posts a small API call to ingest (with token) to mark next N requests for that customer as sampled. Need auth guard.
maya: Security: any trace header we accept must be validated (lengths, allowed chars), and we must strip upstream secrets. Also document compliance: PII scrubbing rules.
nash: Timeline: can we get a runtime PR within ~3 days? Then infra needs ~2 weeks to wire metrics + sampling UI. Console can mock using synthetic traces until ingest is live.
liam: I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow with all owners. Can we agree on sampling defaults now? global_p=0.001, error=100%, per_route_cap=50/min?
sofia: Fine with defaults; we'll expose them in console as editable policy at org level.
maya: Great. Action items: ash add runtime PR (due +3d), liam prototype ingest metrics (2w), sofia wireframe console tiles (1w). I'll create a tracking RFC and link PRs.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: runtime/edge trace-header-parser -> canary on staging at 2026-03-22T09:00Z.
obs-bot: New metric namespace created: rw.trace.{sampled_count, sample_rate, traces_in_window}. Grafana folder: "Trace Rollout" created under /redwood/observability.
liam: thanks — I'll post the sync invite. Any blockers?
nash: None from runtime; just need design for log field name. Suggest 'rw.trace_id' and 'rw.span_id'.
sofia: Works for console.
maya: Ok closing here — will follow up with RFC link in #product and add owners to the RFC. :thumbsup:
